knowledge_rule: Stage 1 missing-information flag when the customer's 'level' answer is exactly 'No'
provenance_status: historical individual provenance not yet identified

source_baseline.note: Clean, single-point addition — git log -S confirms no earlier baseline exists for this exact line. Added because the same commit's level-option rename ('No / gradient present' -> 'No') meant a bare 'No' could no longer rely on the shared uncertain() list.

output_shape_note: Unlike every runStage1Risks() rule migrated so far (which return {text,category,discipline}|null), this stage1MissingInfo() rule returns a plain string|null — stage1MissingInfo()'s own output array is an array of strings, not risk objects. Recorded here so the contract difference is explicit, not assumed identical to the risk-rule schemas.
governance_source: Architect + SPA authorised Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch instruction (2026-08-28), Phase 2: recorded LOCKED-EXISTING, not CONFIRMED and not PROPOSED.
scope_note: This migration covers ONLY this single static-text stage1MissingInfo() line. The shared uncertain()/check() helper (level/services/closeBoundary/base/clearSpan, dynamic interpolated text) is explicitly NOT migrated — see the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch report, Phase 2 section, for why.
notes: Exhaustive practical input space: 'No' produces the missing-info text; 'Not sure', 'Yes', the legacy 'No / gradient present' string, empty string, null, undefined and any unrecognised value all produce null (no flag from this specific rule — note 'Not sure' is separately flagged by the shared uncertain()/check() helper, which remains App-side).
